verdicts.evidence: The seeded element is a project-relative candidate path that can only be returned if it equals an ASKED path, and an asked path is a normalised project path: the string "Stryker was here" is never one in any mission. The only reader of `lexicalTarget` is the `asked.has(c)` lookup, so a candidate that nobody can ask about is inert. Measured 2026-09-25 with the direct suite (test/unit/citations.test.js, 9 tests) and the CLI suite (rules-for-cited, 8): identical results under the mutant.
